The left crease top P=(a,5) satisfies PU=PX: a²=(a-4)²+4, hence a=5/2. Right Q=(11/2,5). Exact reflection checks send U to X across LP and V to X across RQ.

The footprint has vertices L,R,Q,P, height5, bases8 and3. Its area is(8+3)*5/2=55/2. The two reflected triangles lie within that trapezoid and meet at X; their interiors do not create extra holes. Removing each original6.25 triangle once also gives40-12.5=27.5.
